name: kanban
description: A simple, editable Kanban board — create, edit, and drag cards across To Do / In Progress / Done. Data is stored locally; no account, no external service.
author: BrandonYUYU
highlights: Create, edit, delete and move cards across columns
To Do / In Progress / Done lanes with per-card priority
Data stored locally in the app data directory — no credentials, no paid service
Works instantly offline, no build step
